title: Party relationships, mandates and lifecycle validity
workflow: Identify both parties and their institution-specific identity states
Select relationship type and permissible mandate scope
Collect supporting evidence and effective/expiry dates
Validate no contradictory or self-approval relationships are created
Obtain authorized mandate approval where policy requires
Revise, suspend or revoke with notifications and immutable history
requirements: A relationship does not automatically authorize account withdrawal or payment signing
Authority is evaluated per action, institution, time and explicit mandate scope
No revoked or expired mandate can approve a new financial instruction
Guardianship, beneficial ownership and corporate signing authority are independent statuses
Subject and object must be institution-authorized and existence-validated
Evidence must be retained even after a mandate is revoked where legally required
acceptance_tests: Expired mandate denied even with still-valid user login
Beneficial owner without mandate cannot authorize a transaction
Revocation takes effect for subsequent commands
Self-authorization blocked on controlled mandate creation
Historic mandate state reproducible at transaction date
gate: Institution mandate products, delegation policy and local legal/guardian evidence requirements.
